faq.q: How long does a rebrand take?
faq.a: Most brand identity projects take 4 to 8 weeks from the first workshop to final guidelines. Naming or a full rebrand of a large business can take longer.
No. A logo alone rarely fixes a brand problem. We start with strategy and build a complete system, so everything you put out looks and sounds like you.

faq.q: Do you work with brands outside Lahore?
faq.a: Yes. We work with brands across Pakistan, the UAE and beyond, from our studios in Lahore and Dubai.
It depends on scope: a startup identity and a full rebrand for an established company are very different projects. Tell us what you need and we will send a clear proposal.
